title: W3C Web Platform Working Group-relevant MDN issues
description: Issue filed on MDN Web Docs related to pages attached to technologies developed by W3C Web Platform Working Group

items.content_html:
MDN URL

https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Range

What specific section or headline is this issue about?

Instance properties

What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

These interfaces document properties like endContainer and endOffset, but these are already defined on AbstractRange, and aren't overridden by the subclasses.

What did you expect to see?

Per MDN conventions, this means they should be documented once on AbstractRange, and noted on each subclass's landing page as "Also inherits properties from its parent interface, AbstractRange". Which means #42547 and #42707 have to be redone.

Do you have any supporting links, references, or citations?

https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-staticrange and https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-range do not define these properties

Do you have anything more you want to share?

No response
